title: Do the owner's 2026 fills land at the worst price within three sessions either side?
unit: ticker x session x side; several rows on one unit are aggregated to one fill at their quantity-weighted average price

placebo.price_rule: uniform inside the placebo session's unadjusted low-high range
placebo.structure: blocked: fills that share a session date, or share a name with seven-session windows that overlap (centres within six bars), form one cluster; in each placebo set every member of a cluster takes the same offset, drawn from the offsets eligible for all of them, so the common market move the cluster shares under the null is kept; the intraday uniform is independent per fill. The independent-per-fill null is computed at 1,000 draws for comparison only.

bootstrap_unit: cluster (block bootstrap over the same clusters as the null)
verdict_bearing: H1 alone; H2 is a floored secondary whose pass adds the suffix TAIL-ELEVATED and never confirms on its own (Holm across the pair was considered and dropped at the freeze because it took H1's power at the floor below 0.80)

floors.H1_delta_rationale: the minimum detectable effect at 0.80 power under the blocked null (about 0.054 at n = 151), rounded up to 0.01; about 82 bps of price at the median seven-session window width, roughly 3.7 times one-way commission. The economic floor first registered, 0.05, is reported beside it as a disclosure with its own power.
floors.H2_delta_tail_share: MDE at 0.80 power at the one-sided alpha from the blocked placebo null, rounded up to 0.01, fixed at the freeze in coverage.json; by construction powered at least 0.80

power_rule: a clause with power below 0.80 at its floor is demoted: a demoted fail reads UNRESOLVED, a demoted pass reads SUGGESTIVE; neither carries CONFIRMED or REJECTED alone

dividend_handling.primary: rebase every bar of the window to the fill session's adjustment factor f = ac / c, so prices on both sides of an ex-date are on one basis
dividend_handling.sensitivity: exclude any fill whose window holds a detected ex-date (actual side only; the remaining fills' placebo windows keep their rebased ex-dates, and the share of placebo windows holding one is reported)

alignment.rule: a fill whose price lies outside its dated session's low-high range beyond the tolerance is re-dated to the adjacent session whose range holds it (previous session preferred), and counted; a fill that fits neither adjacent session is excluded

bar_defects.fabricated_bar: open = high = low = close equal to the last good close (a no-trade or holiday bar)
bar_defects.range_repair: a session's range must contain its own open and close; where Yahoo prints a high below the open or a low above the close (its London lines do), the range is widened to the prints it reports and the bar is counted as repaired, not dropped
bar_defects.bad_print_rule: a close more than the jump away from the last good close that the NEXT close reverts to within half the jump of that level; a move the next bar does not revert is a move, not a print

explicit_exclusions.reason: known bad print, close 9.16 against 70.78 and 72.36 either side

exclusions: no feed symbol (yf null) or symbol absent from history.json
book type Bond or Cash, or meta noQuote
proxy feed: the book's exchange for the line is not the market the feed symbol trades on (a US ETF standing in for a London UCITS line), so the feed is not the instrument filled
alignment: the fill price lies outside its dated session's range and outside both adjacent sessions' ranges (a feed in other units, or a mis-dated fill that no neighbour explains)
window of seven sessions incomplete: edge of history, a defective bar, or a provisional bar inside it

inputs_frozen_as_extracts.bars: results/bars_used.json, the live Pages history.json cut to the symbols carrying a 2026 fill, bars from 2025-09-01
inputs_frozen_as_extracts.fx: results/fx_used.json, the five SGD pairs from docs/data/fx.json as committed at extraction; the daily close on the fill date (the latest FX day at or before it); SGD fills at 1

stop_conditions_mechanical: bars_used.json or fx_used.json sha256 differs from coverage.json
trades.json or book.json sha256 differs from coverage.json
complete fill count differs from coverage.json
any placebo matrix or any actual score holds a missing value
the vectorised placebo path and the scalar actual path disagree beyond 1e-9 on any fill (parity)
sgd_notional_weighting: quantity x price x fx on the fill date

cost_anchor.formula: per fill (u_actual - median placebo u) x (window high - window low, fill basis) x quantity x fx, summed; null from the same expression on each placebo set
cost_anchor.pnl_source: dashboard YTD P&L card, +S$194,578 (+20.72 per cent), read from the live page on 2026-10-03 at about 14:02 SGT with 55 live quotes and the intraday card baked to 3 October; single-source output of the dashboard's FX-aware total-return FIFO engine
cost_anchor.rate_card_source: register record 2026-08-02-Portfolio-Command-Centre-2, an unreviewed extraction; the ledger's own fee field is the measured comparator, converted to SGD terms
cost_anchor.reading_rule: material if the excess cost in bps of SGD notional exceeds one-way commission in SGD terms; real but sub-commission if H1 passes with bps below it; absent at the registered size on REJECTED; the S$ point estimate and its null sd are reported in every case

sell_regret.status: exploratory, after the primary verdict only
sell_regret.destination_rule: same-currency buys dated within 7 calendar days after the sell, weighted by SGD notional; otherwise foreign cash earning the FX move

excluded.reason: Crasus spin-off unbooked; the mark is distorted

declared_cells: H2 share of fills with u above 0.9 (floored secondary; suffix only)
S2 share worse than all six neighbouring closes
S3 pre leg (t-3 close to fill) and post leg (fill to t+3 close), adverse-oriented
S4 post leg against the pre-leg-tercile-matched placebo post leg (mechanical reversal check)
S5 intraday placement within the fill session's own range, against the uniform 0.5
S6 u at the session close in place of the fill price (day choice alone)
S7 buys alone and sells alone
S9 leave-one-ticker-out range of the H1 effect (thinness)
C1 SGD cost anchor, bps of traded notional, share of 2026 P&L, against commission
X1 sell regret at 20 and 60 sessions (exploratory)
